minicpm5-1b.notes: Chat template ships in the GGUF metadata; use --jinja. Toggle thinking mode per-request via chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking, or disable it server-wide via -rea off / --reasoning-format none.

spark-x2.5-4b.notes: Native Spark2_5ForCausalLM support requires the XHToken/llama.cpp fork. GGUF file names are not hardcoded here: reflex resolves the actual quant file name from the Hugging Face tree API at pull time, matching quantPreference in order.

spark-x2.5-1.7b.notes: Smaller sibling of spark-x2.5-4b, offered by `reflex up` as a lower-memory deep-layer fallback. Same fork requirement and quant-resolution approach.
